label: #3606655: per-user color scheme (MR !16432 @ 170be9e3), pinned to its core base
description: Before: no Color scheme setting on the profile form, no data-color-scheme on <html>, no cookie. After (MR !16432 at 170be9e3): a User settings fieldset with Light/Dark/System radios on /user/1/edit; <html> always carries data-color-scheme="auto"; a customized choice travels in the DrupalColorScheme cookie and an inline head script overrides the attribute. The user.color_scheme cache context is absent by design.
status: ready: current MR revision, core base ced1e263

steps.text: Standard install; Default Admin is the admin theme.
Type /user/1/edit in Page and press Go (both). Scroll to the bottom above Save.
steps.lookFor: After: a Color scheme fieldset with Light / Dark / System radios. Before: no such field.

steps.text: In EACH frame, pick Dark and press Save, then look at the page.
steps.lookFor: After: preference saves and <html data-color-scheme> reflects it. Before: nothing to pick.

expected: After: /user/1/edit shows Color scheme radios and <html> carries data-color-scheme. Before: neither exists.

checks.label: Setup reached: user edit form is on the page
Color scheme radios are on the profile form
JavaScript errors on the page (ignoring the harmless "ResizeObserver loop" notice)

observe.label: Profile form shows a Color scheme choice (Light / Dark / System)
Anything else looks broken (profile form, theme settings)

coverage.note: The combinations that count as tested for this issue (scripts/coverage.mjs). Edit to fit the question the issue asks.
